title: Judge call site #5 — issue review aggregate consolidation
description: Frozen response contract for spec §6.9 #5 (issue review aggregate ambiguity). When `atdd issue review` returns a mixed-verdict aggregate, or when a single pass surfaces a systemic concern (per §6.10 systemic dominates), coach calls `atdd judge` with this schema to consolidate. The `decision` is the routing branch coach executes; the `consolidated_feedback` is what the issue author sees on `request_revision`; `dominant_dimensions` records which of the five §6.10 review dimensions drove the decision. Producer: structured-output LLM via `atdd judge --schema judge-issue-review-aggregate.response.schema.json`. Consumer: `coach.commands.judge_call_sites.route_issue_review_aggregate`. Issue: #523.

decision.description: Routing branch coach takes. `accept` → emit a `coach_ready` decision and proceed past the §4.2 pre-coach precondition. `request_revision` → post `consolidated_feedback` as a GitHub issue comment and emit `pre_coach_paused`. `escalate` → transition the issue to BLOCKED with operator notification.

consolidated_feedback.description: Human-readable consolidation of the disagreement across passes. On `request_revision` this is posted verbatim to the GitHub issue; on `escalate` it is included in the operator notification rationale; on `accept` it is recorded in `decisions.jsonl` for audit.

dominant_dimensions.description: Non-empty subset of the five §6.10 review dimensions that drove the consolidation decision. Lets reviewers pinpoint which dimensions were decisive without re-reading the full per-pass payloads.
